questions.q: What is the two-click path to creating a new custom object?
options: Object Manager → Create → Custom Object
App Manager → New Lightning App
Setup → Flow Builder → New Flow
App Launcher → Search → New
questions.explain: Object Manager's Create menu, then Custom Object, is the standard starting point for any custom object.

questions.q: What three fields do you set when first creating a custom object?
options: Owner, Record Type, Page Layout
Profile, Role, Permission Set
Label, Plural Label, API Name
Tab color, icon, description only
questions.explain: Label, Plural Label, and API Name are set at object creation, regardless of what the object is for.

questions.q: What happens to a lookup relationship's child record if the parent record is deleted?
options: The child record is automatically deleted too
The org is locked until an admin intervenes
The child record becomes a new parent automatically
The child record survives — lookup relationships are independent on deletion
questions.explain: A lookup relationship is loose: deleting the parent does not delete the child record.

questions.q: Per this lesson's rule, when should you choose master-detail over lookup?
options: Whenever the object has more than five fields
Only when the child record genuinely cannot exist without its parent
Master-detail should always be the default choice
Only for objects owned by the System Administrator profile
questions.explain: Master-detail is for a tight, 'can't exist without its parent' relationship — not a default choice.

questions.q: What becomes automatically possible once you create a master-detail relationship field, that a lookup does not allow?
options: Creating more than one custom object
Adding the object to App Manager
Roll-up summary fields on the parent object
Assigning page layouts
questions.explain: Roll-up summary fields (sums, counts, etc. of child records) are only possible across a master-detail relationship, not a lookup.
